scripts.build: npm run build -w @pixopen/core && npm run build -w @pixopen/device && npm run build -w @pixopen/datasources && npm run build -w @pixopen/renderer && npm run build -w @pixopen/server && npm run build -w @pixopen/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @pixopen/core && npm run build -w @pixopen/renderer && concurrently -k -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "PIXOPEN_DEV_UI=1 npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:static: npm run build -w @pixopen/core && npm run build -w @pixopen/renderer && npm run build -w @pixopen/web && npm run dev:server
scripts.serve: npm run build -w @pixopen/core && npm run build -w @pixopen/device && npm run build -w @pixopen/datasources && npm run build -w @pixopen/renderer && npm run build -w @pixopen/server && npm run build -w @pixopen/web && npm run start -w @pixopen/server
